create.name: Storm Faerywolf
create.bio:
Storm Faerywolf is a witch, author and teacher who calls himself a professional warlock. Over more than thirty years he has been initiated into several streams of practical witchcraft, above all the Faery (Feri) tradition, where he has been given the Black Wand, the tradition's mark of a master, and he is also a Reiki master and a trained folk magician. He co-founded Black Rose Witchcraft, serves as chancellor of the online school Modern Witch University, writes a column for The Wild Hunt and has lectured, taught and led ritual in the United States and Europe.

His books include Betwixt and Between and Forbidden Mysteries of Faery Witchcraft, both drawing on Faery lore and practice, The Witch's Name, on taking a magical name, and The Satyr's Kiss, on queer spirituality and sacred sexuality in the Craft; Claiming the Witchfire, on energy work for witches, is due in 2027. He teaches online classes and private apprenticeships, offers consultations and candle and sigil work over Zoom, and hosts Witch Power Daily, a podcast of short guided trances, meditations and rituals. He lives in the San Francisco Bay Area, where he and his partners run an online shop for magical supplies.

books.title: Betwixt and Between
books.author: Storm Faerywolf
books.description: An introduction to the Faery (Feri) path of American traditional witchcraft that comes from Victor and Cora Anderson and Gwydion Pendderwen, covering its history, ideas and foundational practices.

books.title: Forbidden Mysteries of Faery Witchcraft
books.author: Storm Faerywolf
books.description: Darker rites from the Faery tradition, framed as facing one's fears and shadows to strengthen magical will, including oracular work and helping spirits cross over.

books.title: The Satyr's Kiss
books.author: Storm Faerywolf
books.description: A queer-centred guide to witchcraft for men, with spells, rituals and rites of passage, and a strong emphasis on sexuality as part of magical practice.

books.title: The Witch's Name (Revised & Expanded Edition)
books.author: Storm Faerywolf
books.description: Explores the history and mythology of magical names and offers exercises, ritual and journaling for choosing one, for individuals and for covens.

books.title: The Stars Within the Earth
books.author: Storm Faerywolf
books.description: A book of his poetry written as a grimoire of prayers, invocations and spells, finding the sacred within everyday and earthly themes.

books.title: Claiming the Witchfire
books.author: Storm Faerywolf
books.description: A forthcoming book on the energy centres of the body as taught in Anderson Faery witchcraft, with breath and energy practices for ritual, sigils and spirit work. Due June 2027.

courses.title: Black Rose Private Apprenticeship
courses.description: A one-to-one apprenticeship in Black Rose Witchcraft through Modern Witch University, with regular check-ins and optional group chats and online events. Places are limited.

courses.title: Private Consultations and Magical Services
courses.description: Private sessions with Storm over Zoom, plus candle spells and custom sigils worked on a client's behalf for positive aims. He does not perform curses or break-up spells.

free_resources.title: Witch Power Daily
free_resources.description: A podcast of short episodes, each taking one theme and closing with a guided trance, meditation or ritual, to help build a steady daily practice.
